name: DocBlocks
subtitle: Markdown on your own device
description: Write and organize Markdown documents with a visual editor and a source view. Work offline in a device workspace, or choose a work folder from Files. Import an editable copy of a Markdown document, export your work, and share a file through your device's share sheet.
reviewNotes: No account is required. Start with On this device, create a document, then switch between Write and Source. Open a folder grants access only to the chosen workspace. Save opens a system destination picker; Share file opens a separate share sheet.
ownerReviewRequired: Privacy policy URL and platform data-safety answers
Store application records and distribution signing
Screenshots and physical-device qualification described in docs/mobile-plan.md
